source.name: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks — Harvest Reports and Surveys

notes: Per LICENSE (GFP unit + license type), 2025 seasons, from GFP's harvest-projection PDFs at https://gfp.sd.gov/images/Harvest_Reports/: 'WEST RIVER PRAIRIE FIREARM DEER.pdf' (regular season + West River Special Buck), 'EAST RIVER FIREARM DEER.pdf' (regular + East River Special Buck), 'BLACK HILLS DEER.pdf', 'CUSTER STATE PARK DEER.pdf', 'MUZZLELOADER DEER.pdf', 'NATIONAL WILDLIFE REFUGE FIREARM DEER.pdf', 'ARCHERY DEER.pdf' (nonresident public/private table), 'BLACK HILLS CSP PRAIRIE ELK.pdf', 'FIREARM ANTELOPE.pdf', 'CUSTER STATE PARK ANTELOPE.pdf', 'ARCHERY ANTELOPE.pdf', 'SPECIAL ANTELOPE.pdf'. These are email-survey projections (Survey123), not mandatory reports. huntCode uses the same '<prefix>-<code>' scheme as draw/sd.json, so most rows match a 2026 draw row; a few 2025 license types differ from 2026 (e.g. MZD-ST101 vs 2026 ST102). successPct = GFP's 'Hunter Success' column (where a report prints only 'Tag Success', e.g. single-tag antelope, special buck and nonresident archery, that figure). harvest = GFP 'Total Harvest'/'Harvested' projection. hunters = null: GFP prints licenses sold and survey response rate, not hunters afield. residency is set only where GFP splits a row by residency (Special Antelope, nonresident archery). Left out: unlimited / landowner-own-land licenses (not drawn), resident archery (over the counter), access-permit archery, rows with a blank Hunter Success (58D-13, 67A-11, H5A-21 archery). Row sums reconcile to the report totals within rounding (e.g. West River regular 10,254 + 67A-11's 36 vs 10,286 printed). BIGHORNSHEEP: 2024 season from 'South Dakota Game Report 2025-07, 2024 Big Game Harvest Projections' (https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/docs/2024_big_game_annual_report.pdf); Black Hills units BH2+BH4 are reported together (unit 'BH'; 6 licenses incl. 1 auction license, all harvested); no 2025 sheep report is posted. No mountain goat (season closed).
